title: Separate a genuine active joint-preparation obstruction from the failed one-way-permutation inference
statement: Under the explicit public claw-free permutation-pair assumption for h(B,U)=P_B(U), every classical PPT active joint generator Q has TV(Q,Pi)>=1/2-negligible because ideal Pi gives cross-tag equal-h pairs with probability1/2 and any valid such pair is a claw. The ordinary identity-pair generator has exact native marginals/h preservation and TV exactly1/2.

requires: The explicit classical public-instance claw-free permutation-pair security premise, known forward code/exact uniform sampler, with no supplied trapdoor/claw or nonsimulatable prior capability.
provides: Under the explicit public claw-free permutation-pair assumption for h(B,U)=P_B(U), every classical PPT active joint generator Q has TV(Q,Pi)>=1/2-negligible because ideal Pi gives cross-tag equal-h pairs with probability1/2 and any valid such pair is a claw. assumptions: No assertion that such secure pairs exist or that the actual six programs instantiate them. Not implied by ordinary OWP security and not an all-learner/quantum/practical hardness theorem. Exact native marginals alone are insufficient for full-fibre sampling.
costs: Actual uniform native draws, public forward/code work and polynomial prior histories are included in the interface; UNKNOWN is retained in the output law. Strongest simple matched comparator is identity pairing.

body: Order a generated valid cross pair by its tags to extract the claw directly; the reduction uses neither a supplied witness nor a rare label. UNKNOWN remains an output, so aborts cannot hide variation distance. The matched identity-pair simulator witnesses sharpness at this interface. For f=tag, generated relation disagreements may be negligible despite true old-representation distance1/2, but a code-aware analyst can prove that distance directly: this is not a lower bound on all novelty-decision learners. Commuting/verified-forward-cover pairs supply claws and therefore are outside the named security premise. Ordinary OWP existence, quantum algorithms, practical finite security and prior experience containing a trapdoor are not silently included.
